answer.title: Automate Invoice Creation on Job Completion
answer.trigger: A field worker marks a job as complete in the jobs system.
steps: Detect when a job is marked as complete in the jobs system.
Extract the job details, customer information, and logged materials.
Draft a new invoice in the accounts system with the correct charges.
Send the drafted invoice to Emma for review and approval.
answer.ai_help: Reading the completed job details and logged materials to automatically draft the correct invoice line items in the accounts system.
answer.human_approval: Emma must review and approve the draft invoice before it is finalized and sent to the customer.
answer.risk_reason: Mistakes in automated invoicing could result in incorrect billing to customers, leading to payment disputes and lost revenue.
